page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance provides a total of 768.0 GB of system memory, which translates to approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The ecs.r6.26xlarge offers high memory density relative to its compute resources, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that require large in-memory datasets without the overhead of hyperthreading, as it features a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores. Appropriate workloads for this hardware profile include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
